_about: Roumanian Fairy Tales, collected by Mite Kremnitz (1852-1916), adapted and arranged in English by J. M. Percival (New York: Henry Holt, 1885, per the title page). Translations from Ispirescu, Creanga and others, named in the preface. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
